'''2000 GenCon Sealed Deck (12 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held at GenCon, Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 12 August 2000. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1126">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencond1126/ hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencon], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-hayes-hunter-goes-to-gencond1126/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 North American Continental Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' GenCon, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
